# Lab 8.4: Time-bound Access with IAM Conditions

## What We Are Going to Do
Grant a role that expires automatically, and another that only applies to resources with a certain name prefix.

## Steps

1. **Grant access that expires in one hour.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">EXPIRY=$(date -u -d '+1 hour' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:bob@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/compute.viewer \
  --condition="expression=request.time &lt; timestamp('$EXPIRY'),title=expires-1h,description=Temporary access"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **See it in the console.** In **IAM**, Bob's binding shows a **Condition** column with `expires-1h`.

3. **Limit access by resource name.** Bob can only read objects whose names start with `public/`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-cond-lab --location=us-central1 --uniform-bucket-level-access

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:bob@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer \
  --condition="expression=resource.name.startsWith('projects/_/buckets/$PROJECT_ID-cond-lab/objects/public/'),title=public-prefix-only"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Test it.** Upload `public/a.txt` and `private/b.txt`. As Bob, reading `public/a.txt` works. Reading `private/b.txt` is denied.

5. **Wait for the expiry.** After one hour, Bob can no longer list VMs. The binding stays in the policy but no longer matches.

6. **Clean up.** Remove both conditional bindings in the console (**IAM → edit Bob → delete the roles**) and delete the bucket.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-cond-lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Time condition | Access ends automatically |
| Name condition | Access only to matching objects |
| Basic roles | Cannot be used with conditions |
| Expired bindings | Stay in the policy until removed |
